prompt: A desolate post-apocalyptic scavenger's camp set up in the ruins of a building. A small campfire smolders inside a rusty metal barrel. Beside it, a tattered tent is pitched, with a worn-out backpack leaning against it. A salvaged solar panel is wired to a car battery with jumper cables. A gas mask and a crowbar lie on the dusty ground next to a dented cooking pot. Several cans of food are stacked near a length of rope and an old lantern. A canteen sits on a broken tire. A small, cracked mirror hangs from a piece of rebar sticking out of a wall. A shovel is propped against a pile of debris. This is a harsh, survivalist setting; you won't find any signs of comfort like a fluffy pillow, and the area is devoid of any domesticated animals like a dog. The world is disconnected, so a functioning television is out of the question, and there's definitely no fresh newspaper or clean water bottle.
